title: 2023年3月四级真题 第1套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Of the endless troubles that come with being driven from one's home country, losing educational certificates may seem small. But it isn't. Refugees who settle in other countries often find themselves unable to continue on their previous career path due to a new set of employer standards or skills requirements. To solve this problem, the U.S. State Department is posing a solution: online learning.

P2 The State Department will announce a partnership with an online education platform called Coursera. The platform will allow refugees worldwide to take thousands of online courses for free. "Coursera for Refugees" will be available for any non-profit group that supports refugees in any country, as well as individual refugees. They can apply for fully funded access to Coursera's course catalog, which means they can take all of the platform's classes and obtain professional certificates for free. The platform currently offers professor-led lectures on a broad range of topics, from data science to fashion design.

P3 As the world migrant crisis intensifies, employment is becoming a global concern. The new program aims to aid refugees by offering "important skills that will help them in the global economy," Evan Ryan, U.S. assistant secretary of state for educational and cultural affairs, said on a press call last week. "What we don't want to do is not act," added Coursera chief operations officer Lila Ibrahim.

P4 The idea isn't without problems. For one, starting a new career path isn't as simple as watching a few videos and obtaining an online certificate; even those looking to continue previous careers can't simply rely on an online lecture to get them up-to-date on standards, policies, and practices. For another, most of the classes on Coursera are in English, and though there are plans to add translations, language barriers can be a big obstacle. Then there are the questions over the value of massive open online courses (MOOCs) themselves—both for refugees and for average learners.

P5 But it's still early days and there are signs of hope. In 2015, a joint study found 72% of people taking the MOOCs saw career benefits afterwards.

questions.q: Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?
options: To enable them to settle down in host countries.
To allow them to learn as many job skills as possible.
To offer them a platform to pursue advanced degrees.
To help them to meet new employment standards.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?问的是一个具体的发起原因，答案应能在原文中明确找到对应句。

【拆句】Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees?是一个 Why 引导的现在进行时疑问句，主语是机构名，介词短语for refugees点 明服务对象，结构平铺、无陷阱。 51. Why is the U.S. State Department launching an online learning program for refugees? A) To enable them to settle down in host countries. B) To allow them to learn as many job skills as possible. C) To offer them a platform to pursue advanced degrees. D) To help them to meet new employment standards.

【定位】Refugees who settle in other countries often find themselves unable to continue on their previous career path due to a new set of employer standards or skills requirements. To solve this problem, the U.S. State Department is posing a solution: online learning. 在他国安顿的难民常常发现，自己因雇主新一套的标准或技能要求而无法延续原来的职业路 径。为解决这个问题，美国国务院正在推出一个方案：在线学习。

【选项】A) 偷换概念：把前提说成目的 To enable them to settle down in host countries.把项目目的说成帮助难民「在东道 国安顿下来」，但原文中settle in other countries是难民已经发生的状态、是项目的前 提，不是项目的目的。 B) 过度推断：拔高程度词 To allow them to learn as many job skills as possible.把目的扩成「学尽可能多的工 作技能」，而原文目的是「应对一套新的雇主标准」，原文并没有用「尽可能多」这类 极端量词。 C) 偷换概念：证书↔学位 To offer them a platform to pursue advanced degrees.把目的说成「追求高等学 位」，但原文第二段说的是obtain professional certificates，是专业证书而非学位。 D) ✓ 正确 a new set of employer standards or skills requirements ↔new employment standards To solve this problem, the U.S. State Department is posing a solution ↔To help them to meet 预判答案是「帮助难民应对他国雇主的新标准」，与To help them to meet new employment standards.在主语、动作、对象、目的状语上四点全部对应，是唯一与定 位句构成同义替换的选项。 关于"Coursera for Refugees"我们了解到什么? A) 它免费为难民提供广泛的课程。 B) 它为全世界的难民提供免费的在线数据服务。 C) 它允许难民获得各个学术领域的学位。 D) 它为难民提供各种各样的就业机会。

questions.q: What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"?
options: It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge.
It offers free online data services for refugees around the world.
It allows refugees to obtain degrees in various academic fields.
It supplies refugees with a great variety of job opportunities.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"?要求选出关于该项目可以确认的事 实，属于客观信息核对。

【拆句】What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"?结构非常简单，主句是What do we know，介词宾语就是引号里的专名，无干扰修饰。 52. What do we know about "Coursera for Refugees"? A) It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge. B) It offers free online data services for refugees around the world. C) It allows refugees to obtain degrees in various academic fields. D) It supplies refugees with a great variety of job opportunities.

【定位】They can apply for fully funded access to Coursera's course catalog, which means they can take all of the platform's classes and obtain professional certificates for free. The platform currently offers professor-led lectures on a broad range of topics, from data science to fashion design. 他们可以申请由项目全额资助的Coursera课程目录访问权限，这意味着他们可以免费修读该 平台的所有课程并获得专业证书。该平台目前提供由教授主讲的讲座，主题广泛，从数据科 学到时装设计。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 a broad range of topics ↔a wide range of courses for free ↔free of charge 预判要求「免费+各种各样的课」，It provides refugees with a wide range of courses free of charge.在主语、动作、对象、范围、付费方式上五点齐备，是定位句 最干净的同义复述。 B) 偷换概念：把举例项当成核心 It offers free online data services for refugees around the world.把项目说成「提供 免费在线数据服务」，但原文from data science to fashion design中的 data science 只是众多课程主题之一，不是项目所提供的服务内容。 C) 偷换概念：证书↔学位再现 It allows refugees to obtain degrees in various academic fields.说项目能让难民拿 到「各学术领域的学位」，但原文是professional certificates——专业证书而非学位， 也没有强调「学术领域」。 D) 无中生有：用近义类比制造跳跃 It supplies refugees with a great variety of job opportunities.把项目说成提供「多 种多样的工作机会」，但原文从头到尾说的是「课程」与「证书」，不是「工作」。 文章指出全球移民危机的一个后果是什么? A) 收容国的不稳定性增加。 B) 全球经济危机加剧。 C) 更多难民在迁移过程中死亡。 D) 难民发现找工作更加困难。

questions.q: What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis?
options: Instability increases in host countries.
The global economic crisis intensifies.
A lot more refugees die during migration.
Refugees find it more difficult to get a job.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis?直接问「文 章说……的后果是什么」，答案应能在原文明确找到。 53. What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis? A) Instability increases in host countries. B) The global economic crisis intensifies. C) A lot more refugees die during migration. D) Refugees find it more difficult to get a job.

【拆句】What does the passage say is a consequence of the global migrant crisis?是 「What+助动词+主语+谓语+从句宾语」的疑问句，从句is a consequence of...提示答案 的逻辑位置是后果一端，结构平铺。

【定位】As the world migrant crisis intensifies, employment is becoming a global concern. 随着全球移民危机加剧，就业正成为全球性的关切。

【选项】A) 过度推断：从一点滑向全局 Instability increases in host countries.说东道国整体不稳定上升，但原文只说就业一 项成为全球关切，并未提社会稳定层面。 B) 张冠李戴：动词从一个主语挪到另一个主语 The global economic crisis intensifies.说全球经济危机加剧，但原文只说就业问题， 不是「经济危机」；intensifies 在原文里是用来形容 migrant crisis 的，不是 economic crisis。 C) 无中生有：用常识联想替代文本 A lot more refugees die during migration.说更多难民死于迁徙途中，但原文从头到 尾没有涉及死亡话题，属典型无中生有。 D) ✓ 正确 employment is becoming a global concern ↔Refugees find it more difficult to get a job a global concern ↔more difficult 预判结论是「就业难度上升」，本篇主体始终是难民，Refugees find it more difficult to get a job.既保留了主体，又把抽象的「关切」落地到「找工作变难」，是唯一与定 位句因果直接对应的选项。 作者认为是什么导致难民难以参加在线课程? A) 文化环境。 B) 变化的学术要求。 C) 缺乏语言技能。 D) 教学平台的差异。

questions.q: What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses?
options: Cultural environment.
Changed academic requirements.
Lack of language skills.
Difference in teaching platforms.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses?问的是 「作者说」的具体原因，回原文找归因句即可。

【拆句】What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses?主干是 What causes ... difficulty，does the author say是插入语，in taking online courses做后 置定语限定 difficulty，结构稍绕但无陷阱。 54. What does the author say causes refugees' difficulty in taking online courses? A) Cultural environment. B) Changed academic requirements. C) Lack of language skills. D) Difference in teaching platforms.

【定位】For another, most of the classes on Coursera are in English, and though there are plans to add translations, language barriers can be a big obstacle. 另一方面，Coursera上的大多数课程都是英文授课，尽管有添加翻译的计划，语言障碍仍可 能是一个大问题。

【选项】A) 无中生有：用相关话题替换原文话题 Cultural environment.把困难归因到「文化环境」，但原文第四段从未涉及文化差异， 是无中生有。 B) 张冠李戴：把另一困难的原因装到本题 Changed academic requirements.想说的是「学术要求改变」，但原文can't simply rely on an online lecture to get them up-to-date on standards, policies, and practices说的是行业「标准、政策、做法」的更新，而非学术要求；且这是第一条困 难，不是题54问的「上网课的困难原因」，而是「换行业的困难」。 C) ✓ 正确 language barriers can be a big obstacle ↔Lack of language skills most of the classes on Coursera are in English ↔Lack of language skills 预判明确指向「语言」，四个选项中只有Lack of language skills.提及语言；与定位句 构成最干净的因果对应。 D) 偷换概念：把对一物的质疑换成多物之差异 Difference in teaching platforms.说困难是「教学平台之间的差异」，但原文there are the questions over the value of massive open online courses (MOOCs) themselves谈的是对MOOCs整体价值的质疑，不是不同平台之间的差异。 几年前的联合研究关于MOOCs发现了什么? A) 它们帮助解决了学习者的经济问题。 B) 它们使大多数学习者受益。 C) 它们改变了一些学习者的职业道路。 D) 它们提供了最需要的职业技能。

questions.q: What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago?
options: They helped solve learners' financial problems.
They benefited most of the learners.
They changed some learners' career path.
They provided the most needed vocational skills.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago?问一个具体研究的 具体发现，是直白的事实核对。

【拆句】What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago?是过去时一般疑问 句，主语the joint study，宾语为 what，时间状语several years ago提示要找过去时句 子，结构平铺。 55. What did the joint study find about the MOOCs several years ago? A) They helped solve learners' financial problems. B) They benefited most of the learners. C) They changed some learners' career path. D) They provided the most needed vocational skills.

【定位】In 2015, a joint study found 72% of people taking the MOOCs saw career benefits afterwards. 2015年，一项联合研究发现，参加MOOCs课程的人中有72%在之后获得了职业上的益处。

【选项】A) 偷换概念：用常识把「职业」换成「财务」 They helped solve learners' financial problems.说MOOCs帮学习者解决「财务问 题」，但原文只说career benefits——职业益处，不是钱。 B) ✓ 正确 72% of people taking the MOOCs ↔most of the learners saw career benefits afterwards ↔benefited 预判结论是「大多数学习者获益」，They benefited most of the learners.在主语、动 词、对象上三点对应——只是用程度词代替数字、用动词代替名词短语，是最干净的同 义改写。 C) 过度推断：把益处程度拔高到根本改变 They changed some learners' career path.说MOOCs「改变了某些学习者的职业路 径」，但原文只说saw career benefits——获得职业益处，从「获益」到「改变路径」 是过度推断。 D) 过度推断+无中生有：加最高级、加具体内容 They provided the most needed vocational skills.说MOOCs提供「最需要的职业技 能」，但原文只笼统说「职业益处」，并未说提供了什么具体技能，更没有「最需要」 这种最高级。
